definitions.explanation: Difficult to perceive or describe precisely; requiring careful distinction.
In casual speech, used to express uncertainty or a lukewarm response. A softer way to say something isn't quite good.

examples.english: The difference between the two colors is subtle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{微妙|びみょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: My relationship with him has become delicate/complicated.

examples.japanese: 「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧？」「うーん、{微妙|びみょう}…」
{微妙|びみょう}な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've become able to tell subtle differences in flavor.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{来|こ}られる→来る：00254_kuru⟧？」「{微妙|びみょう}。⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。」
examples.english: "Can you come tomorrow?" "Not sure. I don't know yet."

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧、{微妙|びみょう}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。⟦{期待|きたい}はずれ→期待はずれ：23139_kitaihazure⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: That movie was so-so, wasn't it? It didn't live up to expectations.

notes:
USAGE: {微妙|びみょう} has two distinct usages:

1. Traditional meaning: subtle, delicate, requiring careful attention to perceive or handle
2. Colloquial meaning: iffy, questionable, not quite satisfactory (especially among younger speakers)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {微妙|びみょう}な⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ (subtle difference)
- {微妙|びみょう}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (delicate issue)
- {微妙|びみょう}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ (awkward position)

FORMS:
- {微妙|びみょう}に (subtly, delicately)
